title: New Era: Origins
description: Transform your Minecraft world with dragons, new ores, armor, weapons, tools, mobs, structures, and RPG-inspired progression. More exploration, more combat, and more reasons to keep adventuring.
body:
# New Era: Origins

*A new adventure begins.*

New Era: Origins transforms the vanilla experience into a larger, richer world filled with new possibilities. Explore vast landscapes, discover powerful resources, craft advanced equipment, encounter dangerous creatures, and embark on an adventure where every journey leads to something new.

From mighty dragons and unique mobs to new ores, weapons, tools, and armor, New Era expands Minecraft while preserving the charm that makes the game special. Whether you're building, exploring, fighting, or simply surviving, there's always another challenge waiting beyond the horizon.

## Features

- 🐉 Dragons and fantasy creatures
- ⛏️ New ores and materials
- ⚔️ New weapons and combat content
- 🛡️ Powerful armor and equipment
- 👾 Additional mobs and encounters
- 🌎 Enhanced world generation
- 🗺️ Exploration-focused gameplay
- 📈 Semi-RPG progression
- ✨ Hundreds of new things to discover

## Why Play New Era?

Unlike traditional RPG modpacks, New Era: Origins focuses on expanding the core Minecraft experience. The goal is not to replace vanilla gameplay, but to enhance it with more content, more progression, more exploration, and more reasons to keep adventuring.

## Requirements

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- **Minimum RAM:** 4 GB
- **Recommended RAM:** 6 GB

## Beta Notice

This is the first public beta release of New Era: Origins.

As a beta version, you may encounter bugs, balancing issues, or unfinished features. Feedback and bug reports are greatly appreciated and will help shape future updates.

Discord: **xpozeed**

## Begin Your Journey

Explore ancient lands, uncover hidden treasures, defeat powerful enemies, collect legendary gear, and discover a world full of adventure.
